youtube_title: Best Before vs Expiry Date: Which One Is Still Safe? | Rules You Didn't Know #27 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #27. Two packets: one past its best before date, one past its expiry date. Which one could still be safe? Comment A or B!
Answer: A. Under FSSAI's labelling rules, best before is a quality date: after it the food may still be safe if the pack is intact and stored right, though the quality may drop. Expiry or use by is a safety date: after it the food may not be safe and must not be sold. Every pack must show the date of manufacture or packing and the expiry or use by date; best before is optional extra information.
Source: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations 2020, Reg 2(1) and 5(10).

Rules You Didn't Know #27 🥫 Best before nikal gaya vs expiry nikal gayi, kaunsa abhi bhi safe ho sakta hai?
FSSAI rules: BEST BEFORE = quality date. Uske baad taste thoda kam ho sakta hai, par pack theek ho aur sahi store kiya ho to food safe reh sakta hai.
EXPIRY / USE BY = safety date. Uske baad safe nahi maana jaata, aur dukaan bech hi nahi sakti.
Har pack pe manufacture date + expiry likhna zaroori. Best before optional.
